author: bpatrick
html: Sorry about the interruption. akimbo isn’t dead yet.

comments.author: skanerd777
comments.html: Hooray!!! I was beginning to get worried.

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.html: Haha, thanks for the comments/concern. I’ll field this question. Brian forgot to renew his domain, but the hosting is on my server (where I also have my douchebag blog) for some reason when he got everything straightened out my switch to activate Brian’s new domain (in case he couldn’t buy the old one back) apparently resulted in pointing the REAL domain to my blog. Sorry about that, all is well for now. As it turns out, the registrar Brian used is sort of difficult to deal with, he is in the process of transferring it to someone more reputable. For now think happy thoughts and try to forget about the horrors you had seen.

comments.author: skanerd777
comments.html: Just glad to have you back. Haha. Now finish the dang Curious Urgency storyline. Haha. I got a curious urgency to find out what happens to this guy.
